name: Thermo Nunc 167008 96 well
author: Ramona Optics
notes: Thermo Scientific Nunc MicroWell 96 well, Nunclon Delta-treated, flat-bottom microplate, clear, sterile, with lid. Dimensions from Thermo Fisher product specification drawing D03031 'F96 MicroWell Plate, High Flange, PS' (Roskilde site), cross-checked against plate guide brochure D10948 p.20-21. Units in meters. Base length 127.8 mm (A), base width 85.5 mm (B), overall height 14.4 mm +/- 0.2 (F). Well spacing (pitch) 9 mm (K); the drawing dimensions the spacing once, so the 9 mm y pitch is not separately vendor-confirmed. A1 well center is 14.3 mm from the left edge (H) and 11.3 mm from the top edge (J). Well top diameter 7.0 mm (G1), bottom diameter 6.2 mm (G2), inside depth 11.4 mm (L), flat bottom. Total well volume 400 uL, working range 50-250 uL. Well bottom thickness is not published; the difference between the inside and external well-floor standoffs implies about 1.1 mm. The two vendor documents disagree on the inside-well-floor standoff (3.0 mm in D10948 vs 3.2 mm in D03031). Thermo states all its microplates meet ANSI/SBS 1-2004. Note that drawing D03012 covers a different pinch-bar mould and does not apply to this part. Use 'pitch' and origin reference to compute all well centers.
